_comment_original_fail_session_id: REQUIRED: The UUID of the session that failed review. Find this in the review failure console output or in .ai-review-log.jsonl.
_comment_original_fail_timestamp: REQUIRED: The ISO 8601 timestamp of the failed review run (e.g., '2026-06-05T02:00:23+10:00').
_comment_normalized_diff_hash: REQUIRED: The SHA-256 hash of the normalized staged diff, displayed in the failed review console output.

findings._comment_finding_id: REQUIRED: The ID of the finding you are contesting (e.g., 'FID-1').
findings._comment_rebuttal_type: REQUIRED: The category of your rebuttal. Must be one of: 'FALSE_POSITIVE', 'SPEC_REQUIREMENT', 'ARCHITECTURAL_INVARIANT', 'OUT_OF_SCOPE'.
findings._comment_spec_reference: REQUIRED for 'SPEC_REQUIREMENT' and 'ARCHITECTURAL_INVARIANT' types: Link or path to the specification file (e.g., 'docs/planning/specs/SPEC-123.md#L45-L50') and quote the relevant section verbatim.
findings._comment_evidence: REQUIRED: Verifiable technical evidence. Assertions without verifiable facts will be rejected. You MUST include: (1) The exact, verbatim commit message; (2) The spec ID and its status; (3) Citing specific acceptance criteria the diff implements; (4) A description of the diff's contents (file names, line counts, and exact nature of change).
